title: Low-pH amylase engineering must balance acid stability and activity

input.message: 酶的名称：GH13 淀粉酶。目标：把最适 pH 从 6.0 降到 4.5-5.0，同时保留淀粉水解活性。已有序列和 AlphaFold 结构。

must_have: identify GH13 catalytic and calcium-binding guardrails
separate pH-shift hypotheses from experimentally validated facts
prefer surface electrostatic and loop candidates before catalytic-core changes
must_not_have: recommend catalytic acid/base or nucleophile mutation as a normal candidate
claim pH optimum improvement without assay validation
